tools.name: laudus_get_customer
tools.description: Get a customer (addresses, contact data, credit limit, category, salesman, price list) by id. GET /sales/customers/{id}.

tools.name: laudus_get_sales_invoice
tools.description: Get a sales invoice with its lines, taxes and totals by id. GET /sales/invoices/{id}.

tools.name: laudus_get_sales_order
tools.description: Get a sales order with its lines by id. GET /sales/orders/{id}.

tools.name: laudus_get_sales_quote
tools.description: Get a sales quote with its lines by id. GET /sales/quotes/{id}.

tools.name: laudus_get_product
tools.description: Get a product (SKU, description, category, units, prices) by id. GET /production/products/{id}.

tools.name: laudus_get_supplier
tools.description: Get a supplier by id. GET /purchases/suppliers/{id}.

tools.name: laudus_get_purchase_invoice
tools.description: Get a purchase invoice with its lines by id. GET /purchases/invoices/{id}.

tools.name: laudus_get_purchase_order
tools.description: Get a purchase order with its lines by id. GET /purchases/orders/{id}.

tools.name: laudus_get_journal_entry
tools.description: Get an accounting journal entry (comprobante) with its lines by id. GET /accounting/journal/entries/{id}.

tools.name: laudus_customer_pending_invoices
tools.description: Unpaid sales invoices (accounts receivable). Give customer_id for one customer, or leave it out for all customers. GET /sales/customers/{id}/pendingInvoices or /sales/customers/pendingInvoices.

tools.name: laudus_customer_credit_limit
tools.description: A customer's credit limit and how much of it is used. GET /sales/customers/{id}/creditLimit.

tools.name: laudus_list_customer_contacts
tools.description: The contact people of a customer. GET /sales/customers/{id}/contacts.

tools.name: laudus_sales_invoice_receipts
tools.description: The customer payments (cobros) applied to one sales invoice. GET /sales/invoices/{id}/receipts.

tools.name: laudus_pending_sales_orders
tools.description: The ids of sales orders not yet delivered, optionally for one customer or a due-date range. GET /sales/orders/pending.

tools.name: laudus_sales_report
tools.description: Invoiced sales totals grouped by day of week, day of month, month, year, salesman, customer, customer category, product, product category, county, state or branch, for a date range and optional filters. GET /reports/sales/invoices/{group}.

tools.name: laudus_get_product_stock
tools.description: Stock of one product, optionally as of a date, in one warehouse or lot; with by_warehouse true, the stock in each warehouse. GET /production/products/{id}/stock or /stockByWarehouses.

tools.name: laudus_list_stock
tools.description: Stock of every product, optionally as of a date, for one warehouse or one product category. Can be large: filter by warehouse or category. GET /production/products/stock.

tools.name: laudus_product_kardex
tools.description: The stock movements (kardex) of one product, optionally to a date and for one warehouse. GET /production/products/{id}/kardex.

tools.name: laudus_balance_sheet
tools.description: The balance sheet (balance general) as of a date, either the standard layout or the totals layout. GET /accounting/balanceSheet/standard or /totals.

tools.name: laudus_profit_and_loss
tools.description: The profit and loss statement (estado de resultados) for a date range. GET /accounting/profitAndLoss.

tools.name: laudus_general_ledger
tools.description: The general ledger (libro mayor) movements of an account or a range of account numbers, for a date range. GET /accounting/ledger.

tools.name: laudus_purchase_ledger
tools.description: The purchases ledger (libro de compras) for a year and month. GET /purchases/invoices/ledger.

tools.name: laudus_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: creates a new customer in Laudus (the customer id is assigned by Laudus; the customer record is not an invoice and sends nothing). Check laudus_list_customers for the RUT first to avoid duplicates. Laudus may require more fields than given and answers with its validation message. POST /sales/

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: laudus_list_customers, laudus_list_sales_invoices, laudus_list_sales_orders, laudus_list_sales_quotes, laudus_list_sales_receipts, laudus_list_products, laudus_list_product_categories, laudus_list_warehouses, laudus_list_salesmen, laudus_list_suppliers, laudus_list_purchase_invoices, laudus_list_purchase_orders, laudus_list_accounts, laudus_list_journal_entries, laudus_list_cost_centers, laudus_create_customer · Private data: laudus_list_sales_invoices, laudus_get_customer, laudus_list_customer_contacts, laudus_create_customer · Public sink: laudus_list_customers, laudus_list_sales_invoices, laudus_list_sales_orders, laudus_list_sales_quotes, laudus_list_sales_receipts, laudus_list_products, laudus_list_product_categories, laudus_list_warehouses, laudus_list_salesmen, laudus_list_suppliers, laudus_list_purchase_invoices, laudus_list_purchase_orders, laudus_list_accounts, laudus_list_journal_entries, laudus_list_cost_centers, laudus_create_customer.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
